long_biography.plain_text:
William Whyte Tait Sr. spent decades in Fraserburgh's commercial fishing industry. He was already a director of Klondyke Fishing Company by the end of 1988 and served until June 2026. The business developed a modern pelagic fleet within a Tait family enterprise that involved successive generations in management, skippering and shareholding.

Tait's work also extended into seafood processing. He joined Denholm Seafoods as a founding director and remained on the board for nearly eighteen years. The company processes and preserves fish, crustaceans and molluscs, complementing Klondyke's harvesting operations. Separately, the charitable trust bearing Tait's name supports poverty relief, education and health and has historically been funded by donations from him and his family.
